capabilities: Search ~5,130 Tabler icons in a picker grid and insert the chosen one as inline SVG at the cursor
Set the default pixel size of inserted icons
Replace built-in callout glyphs with Tabler icons across all callout types in the TBDL theme
Toggle theme integration from settings, the ribbon, or the command palette
disambiguation: The theme integration only works with the TBDL theme; inserting icons into notes works anywhere.
extras: An internet connection is required on first use because the picker fetches icon SVGs from the jsDelivr CDN; the 19 callout icons used for theme integration are bundled and work offline. Inline SVGs render in Reading view but appear as raw HTML in Live Preview. The TBDL theme is required for the callout-glyph feature. Only one icon-set plugin (Lucide or Tabler) should be active at a time to avoid conflicting theme variables.
intentEvidence: swap the default callout glyphs of the TBDL theme for Tabler icons
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to browse and insert icon glyphs into notes or to restyle the default callout icons with a different icon set.
